attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Knowledge or Divine 18
attributes.name: Rasping Rift Portal
attributes.powers:
If undefeated, you are dealt 1d6+1 Force damage, then 1d6+1 Mental damage that may not be reduced. Leave this barrier faceup on its location deck; characters at this location encounter this barrier as their first exploration each turn.

After you act, move to a random other location.
